description: List Brain entries newest first, to review or manage knowledge. Filter by status (active, pending or archived), types and plain text q; scope=agency lists the agency Brain shared with this workspace. Rows carry snippets: use aidelly_get_brain_entry for full content. Pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page. Use aidelly_search_brain to find knowledge by topic. Read-only.

q.description: Plain text matched against titles and content.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_list_brain_entries
title: List Brain Entries
